about: Captains who hire able hands (game/hand.py): each flies a route of their own and posts berths on the board where they dock. Their ships are in game/hand.py (NAMED_SHIPS). Names from the pool in the project's names list.

plumb.name: Ola Plumb
plumb.about: captain of the Level Best, a Hansa hauler; honest to a fault, and the fault shows in her margins

ghillie.name: Jak Ghillie
ghillie.about: captain of the Low Water, a hauler that files no manifest; pays well and does not explain

caspic.name: Lieutenant Caspic
caspic.about: commands the Sealed Orders, a Mandate courier; never two turns in one place

vrtoch.name: Dr Vrtoch
vrtoch.about: runs the Errata, a research ship that should not exist after the Debacle, on a whim and a grant nobody signed

caboose.name: Brother Caboose
caboose.about: rides the Clean Lading at the back of every needle and guards the tail; a Cargolyte, and hires anyone who will sign the lading
